course_name_original: Principles of Atatürk and Revolution History I
course_name_en: Principles of Atatürk and Revolution History I

learning_outcomes.text: Acquires a knowledge of the sources belonging to the Principles of Atatürk
Apprehends the renovation movements in Ottoman State
Apprehends the historical origins of Atatürk’s Principles
Understand the state structure of Turkish Republic
Apprehends the Turkish case in 21th century
Apprehends Atatürk’s understanding of republic and peace

syllabus_topics: Content and aim of history of Ataturk Principles and Revolution
The structure of Ottoman Empire and its dissolution reasons
Recovery and reform efforts in the state
Constitutional development and intellectual transactions in the state
The Ottoman geopolitics and foreign policy
The administration of CUP and last phase
Mondros Armistice and Occupations, Paris Peace Conference
National Independence Determination and Mustafa Kemal
Mustafa Kemal’s opinions and his pass to Anatolia
